objectives: Describe what is broken at home
Ask a technician to repair an appliance
Use can and could to make polite requests

grammar.explanation: We use can and could to ask someone to do something politely. Could is a little more polite than can, and adding please makes the request softer. For example: Can you check the machine? Could you come today, please?
grammar.explanationAr: نستخدم can و could لطلب شيء من شخص بشكل مهذّب، وصيغة could أكثر تهذيبًا من can، وإضافة please تجعل الطلب ألطف.

examples.en: Can you check the switch, please?
examples.ar: هل يمكنك فحص المفتاح من فضلك؟

vocabulary.example: The technician knows this machine well.
Put the milk in the fridge.
There is a leak in the pipe.
I hear a noise from the kitchen.
We need a new part for the pump.

lt.en: The washing machine is not working.
Can you fix my fridge today?
The oven door won't close.
lt.alt: The oven door will not close.

lt.en: There is a water leak under the sink.
The heater makes a loud noise.
When can the technician arrive?
The technician will come tomorrow morning.
How much does the repair cost?
I need to repair the dishwasher.
Could you send someone today?
The light switch doesn't work.
Can you check the air conditioner?
It stopped working last night.
The machine is still under warranty.
lt.alt: The appliance is still under warranty.

lt.en: Do you have the spare part?
The part will arrive next week.
Please come as soon as possible.
lt.ar: يرجى المجيء في أقرب وقت ممكن.

lt.en: Is the repair expensive?
No, it is a small problem.
The pump is broken again.
Can you repair it this time?
I called you about my broken oven.
What is the problem exactly?
The fridge is not cold enough.
It makes a loud noise at night.
How old is the appliance?
It is only two years old.
Could you give me a price first?
Yes, we check it free of charge.
The repair takes about an hour.
Do I need to stay at home?
lt.ar: هل أحتاج إلى البقاء في المنزل؟

lt.en: No, you can go out.
The kitchen sink is blocked.
Water is coming from the bottom.
Turn off the water, please.
Is it fixed now?
Yes, try it and see.
It works fine now.
Thank you for coming so fast.
Here is your bill for the repair.
When can you come to fix it?
Of course, we take cards.
